statement: Smooth real cubic surfaces modulo GL4(R) have five connected components indexed j=0,...,4, with real-line counts 27,15,7,3,3. Each component is the quotient of real hyperbolic 4-space minus a specified arrangement by the projective integral orthogonal group of -x0^2+sum_(i=1)^4 m_i xi^2, with exactly j coefficients m_i=3 and the others 1. The final two types have real loci RP2 and RP2 disjoint union S2, distinguishing chambers with the same count 3.

answer.qualification: Modulo real projective equivalence; the two 3-line types have different real topology. The short source announces the result and sketches its proof.

scope: Smooth real cubic surfaces modulo GL(4,R), the base moduli for the 27-line problem.
notes: Chambers are in moduli modulo real projective equivalence. Two components have the same real-line count 3, showing why counts alone do not classify chambers. This short paper announces the results and sketches proof.
